speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: Ewes are in the pen. The first buds are pink at the tip. You'll see them from the lane.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The basket is thine before we ask anything of the afternoon.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: He has the hurdle to mend. Take the cup, Will, and do not make him a host.

speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: The ground's cold yet. You'll take a cup and go before the light does. She never could abide being waited on, our Anne.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we will not keep thee. The buds are enough of a showing.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Go on, brother. We know the path.

speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: You'll take the cup. I am back at the pen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Taken. The pen, and the pink at the tip.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: That is enough thanks. Let him work.
